sourceText: Japani humiliki visiwa karibu 7,000 (kikubwa zaidi kikiwa Honshu), hivyo kuifanya Japani kuwa kisiwa cha 7 kikubwa zaidi duniani!
referenceText: Japans holds nearly 7,000 islands (the biggest being Honshu), making Japan the 7th largest island in the world!
